rationale: Mufaddal brings 15+ years of embedded systems and automotive software expertise (embedded Linux, Bluetooth, OTA updates) while Charlie is building Expo to democratize software development across mobile, web, and increasingly AI-powered builders. Their skill sets complement strongly—Mufaddal's deep firmware and connectivity background could inform how Expo handles performance-critical IoT and embedded use cases, while Charlie's conviction about AI expanding who can build software aligns with bringing software development to hardware-constrained environments.
intro_message: mufaddal.esmael@gmail.com, meet Charlie Cheever — Mufaddal's expertise in embedded systems and automotive software could be valuable as Expo expands into IoT and hardware-adjacent platforms, and Charlie's vision for AI-powered builders might open new possibilities for embedded development workflows.
